name: A Recipe For Death
summary: From the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell sends you to Pyrewood Village in A Recipe For Death. You seek Apothecary Berard's notes on the ancient blight that wiped out Lake Lordamere's aquatic life.

sections.title: A Mind Lost to Shadow
sections.body: Apothecary Berard once stood among the Royal Apothecary Society's most promising researchers. He worked in Pyrewood Village, studying past ecological disasters for the Forsaken's alchemical pursuits. Then Archmage Arugal unleashed shadow magic across Silverpine Forest, and Berard fell under its curse. His mind gave way, binding him as a servant to the mage.

sections.title: The Secrets of Lake Lordamere
sections.body: Master Apothecary Faranell considers Apothecary Berard beyond saving, but the Royal Apothecary Society still needs his research. Berard recorded the traits of a forgotten plague that wiped out all aquatic life in Lake Lordamere long ago. His journal lies in the Pyrewood Village Inn. You are to recover it and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher, so the Society can adapt the plague's deadly properties for the Dark Lady's arsenal.

faq.answer: Apothecary Berard was once one of the Royal Apothecary Society's most promising researchers in Silverpine Forest. Archmage Arugal's shadow curse shattered his mind and bound him as a thrall in Pyrewood Village.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want Berard's journal?
faq.answer: Berard's journal records an ancient plague that wiped out all aquatic life in Lake Lordamere. It preserves the plague's traits for the Royal Apothecary Society.
Berard's journal lies in his study on an upper floor of the Pyrewood Village Inn, toward the rear of the village. The afflicted apothecary still guards his former quarters.

aliases: who do i bring the journal to
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel receives the journal at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He oversees the Royal Apothecary Society's field operations there.
Archmage Arugal's shadow magic from nearby Shadowfang Keep corrupted Pyrewood Village. The curse warped the villagers' minds and bodies, binding them to Arugal's will.

Master Apothecary Faranell heads the Royal Apothecary Society from the Apothecarium in the Undercity. He oversees the creation of blights and venoms to defend the Forsaken and eradicate their enemies.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society's cold pragmatism. When Berard was lost to madness, the Society set aside his tragedy to salvage his lethal research.
As Horde, you help the Royal Apothecary Society in Silverpine secure the Forsaken's borders against the wild terrors Arugal unleashed.
